correctness.rationale: Reconstructed a PL homeomorphism between involution-fixed geometric realizations of independence complexes and orbit-conflict independence complexes: barycentric coefficients are constant on each vertex orbit and normalized by its cardinality. For ν i↦−i, all four label orbits form simple P4 and the quotient is μ_l(P4); published simple-base-graph theorem makes its independence complex contractible since Ind(P4) and its doubled counterpart are contractible. For ε i↦1−i, orbit endpoints have internal top edges and therefore disappear only at the top; non-top cross-level relation is {(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,2),(2,1),(2,2)}. Its two complete adjacent levels form an ordinary C6, Ind(C6)≃S1∨S1. Open-neighborhood inclusion N((1,a))⊆N((3,a)) yields the all-l 3-step deletion/isolated-join A_l≃Ind(C6)*A_{l−3}, with explicitly analyzed A0,A1,A2. Apex cofiber yields contractible at l≡1 mod3, wedge of 2^{k+1} S^{2k+1} at l=3k+2, and wedge of 2^k S^{2k} at l=3k. Independently reconstructed original μ_l(C6) vertex orbits/conflicts and computed exact mod-two homology for both reflection types l=1..5; observed ε l=2:2 circles, l=3:2 two-spheres, l=5:4 three-spheres, and ν contractible in all five. This finite test corroborates but does not imply the infinite fold proof.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge PASS for the explicitly classified geometric fixed sets under both C6 reflection conjugacy classes. Carnero Bravo 2026 proves nonequivariant homotopy of generalized Mycielskians over simple base graphs; the vertex-axis quotient is such a simple-path instance, but the edge-axis quotient has two self-relations in its cross-layer relation and restricted top, so the general theorem does not cover it directly. Goyal–Shukla–Singh treats complete graphs, not these reflection quotients. No exact all-depth fixed-space dichotomy found.
residual_risks: An unindexed equivariant result for Mycielskians of cycles could cover the same fixed spaces.
Only the two base-cycle reflection conjugacy classes are classified, not all subgroups or equivariant ambient homotopy equivalence.
The infinite fold proof is essential; bounded homology checks alone would not establish all depths.

value.rationale: Two inequivalent involutions of one natural C6 generalized Mycielskian family produce dramatically different geometric fixed loci: one always contractible and the other exponentially many homology-sphere generators with a three-periodic degree law. This geometric orbit analysis is a substantive equivariant structural result across every depth and supplies natural fixed-set boundary data, rather than a tiny numerical witness.

limitations: All depths l≥1 but only C6 and its two reflection classes.
Fixed spaces are geometric fixed loci, not simple pointwise-fixed vertex subcomplexes.
